label: Tech employers
description: Estimated count of tech establishments located within a straight-line 25 km radius of the town centroid, based on U.S. Census Bureau 2023 ZIP Code Business Patterns (ZBP) for NAICS 51 (Information sector proxy, including software publishers) and NAICS 5415 (Computer Systems Design and Related Services). Mapped strictly using official 2023 Census ZCTA Gazetteer centroid coordinates (unmatched PO-box ZIPs omitted as coverage gaps).
source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2023 ZIP Code Business Patterns (ZBP) & 2023 ZCTA Gazetteer
